text: Don't pass judgment on others, or judgment will come back on you.
Whatever standard you judge by will be used to measure you, and whatever amount you measure out will be measured back to you.
Why do you stare at the sawdust speck in your brother's eye and completely miss the beam of wood in your own?
How can you say, 'Let me take that speck out of your eye,' while a beam is sitting in your own eye?
You pretender — first take the beam out of your own eye, and then you'll see well enough to remove the speck from your brother's.
Don't give what's sacred to dogs, and don't scatter your pearls in front of pigs, or they'll trample them and then turn and tear you apart.
Ask, and it will be given to you; search, and you'll find it; knock, and the door will open for you.
Because everyone who asks receives, everyone who searches finds, and the door opens for everyone who knocks.
Which of you, if your child asked for bread, would hand over a stone?
Or if they asked for a fish, would hand over a snake?
So if you, flawed as you are, know how to give your children good things, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask him?
So in everything, treat people the way you'd want to be treated — that's the whole point of the Law and the Prophets.
Go in through the narrow gate. The wide gate and the easy road lead to ruin, and many walk through it.
But the gate is narrow and the road is hard that leads to life, and only a few ever find it.
Be on guard against false prophets. They come to you looking like harmless sheep, but underneath they are hungry wolves.
You'll know them by what they produce. Do people gather grapes from thornbushes, or figs from thistles?
In the same way, a healthy tree produces good fruit, but a diseased tree produces bad fruit.
A healthy tree can't bear bad fruit, and a diseased tree can't bear good fruit.
Any tree that doesn't produce good fruit gets cut down and thrown into the fire.
So you'll recognize them by what they produce.
Not everyone who calls me 'Lord, Lord' will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who carries out my Father's will in heaven.
On that day many will say to me, 'Lord, Lord, didn't we prophesy in your name, and drive out demons in your name, and do many miracles in your name?'
And I will tell them plainly, 'I never knew you. Get away from me, you who do wrong.'
So everyone who hears what I'm saying and acts on it is like a wise man who built his house on solid rock.
The rain poured, the rivers rose, the winds beat against that house, and it stood firm, because it was founded on rock.
But everyone who hears what I'm saying and doesn't act on it is like a fool who built his house on sand.
The rain poured, the rivers rose, the winds beat against that house, and it collapsed — and its collapse was total.
When Jesus finished saying these things, the crowds were stunned by his teaching,
because he taught them like someone with real authority, not like their scribes.
